description: Six switched intervals that add together: every gate held high, and every button held down, adds its own number of semitones to one pitch output

params.text: Sets how many semitones the top row adds, -6 to +12, rounded to a whole semitone
Held down, adds the number of semitones the knob is set to
Held down, takes away one semitone

inputs.text: Held above 1V, adds the number of semitones the knob is set to
Held above 1V, takes away one semitone

outputs.text: 10V while any gate is high or any button is held, 0V when none of them is
The semitones of every row that is currently on, added up and put out at a twelfth of a volt each

notes: both outputs take their channel count from whichever gate input carries the most channels, and a button pressed on the panel applies to every one of those channels
the lamps glow yellow while the module is running one channel and blue while it is running more
